title.en: Restore a backup with a preview, not a blind overwrite
title.zh: 备份恢复：先看差异，再决定覆盖哪些记录

summary.en: Read the FieldLens v1.2 import path: four record categories, explicit conflict choices and a second check before saving.
summary.zh: 沿着 FieldLens v1.2 的导入流程，梳理四类记录、冲突选择和保存前的再次检查，说明备份里包含什么。

basis.en: A version-specific review of FieldLens v1.2 (3ab5e7f), domain.js and backup-view.js. Eighteen existing domain/practical checks passed during the preceding repository review; this note does not claim a new model or full UI evaluation.
basis.zh: 针对 FieldLens v1.2（3ab5e7f）的 domain.js 和 backup-view.js 阅读记录。此前仓库整理已复跑 18 项现有领域逻辑与实用功能检查；本文不新增模型性能或全界面验收结论。

title.en: A valid JSON file can still be the wrong restore
title.zh: 能解析 JSON，不代表可以安全恢复

paragraphs.en: A backup may contain new samples, exact duplicates, a revised note with the same id, or a malformed region. Restoring all of them with one assignment hides the decisions that matter.
paragraphs.zh: 备份里可能有新样本、完全重复的记录、同编号但备注不同的记录，也可能有格式错误的检测区域。一次赋值覆盖全部内容，会把这些需要判断的差异藏起来。

paragraphs.en: In this version parseBackup validates the application and schema, normalizes records, and classifies each entry before anything is persisted. The UI shows a preview so the user can choose.
paragraphs.zh: 该版本的 parseBackup 先检查应用标识和格式版本，规范化记录并分类。此时还没有保存数据，界面会展示预览，让用户再作选择。

title.en: Four outcomes should lead to different actions
title.zh: 四种检查结果，对应不同处理

bullets.en: New: the id does not exist locally. Adding it is selected by default.
bullets.zh: 新增：本地不存在相同编号，默认勾选添加。

bullets.en: Duplicate: normalized content is identical. Skip it.
bullets.zh: 重复：规范化后的内容完全一致，直接跳过。

bullets.en: Conflict: the id exists but content differs. Keep the existing record unless the user explicitly chooses replacement.
bullets.zh: 冲突：编号相同但内容不同，默认保留本地记录；只有明确选择后才覆盖。

bullets.en: Invalid: validation fails, or the backup itself repeats an id. Show the reason and skip the entry.
bullets.zh: 无效：字段检查失败，或备份文件内部编号重复，显示原因并跳过。

title.zh: 预览之后，数据仍可能变化

paragraphs.en: backup-view captures the current record list before displaying the dialog. At confirmation it compares the current list again. If it changed, the user must close and re-import, rather than apply choices to an unseen baseline.
paragraphs.zh: backup-view 在打开预览时记录当前列表，确认时再比对一次。如果这期间记录发生变化，就要求关闭后重新导入，避免把之前的选择套用到已经变化的数据上。

paragraphs.en: mergeBackup calculates a new list and rejects a result above the 30-record history limit before persistence. When saving fails, the dialog keeps an error visible. This is a local application guard, not a distributed transaction or an automatic multi-device merge protocol.
paragraphs.zh: mergeBackup 先计算新列表；超过 30 条历史记录上限就拒绝，不先删除旧记录来腾位置。保存失败时弹窗继续显示错误。这是本地应用的保护逻辑，不能当作分布式事务或多设备自动合并协议。

title.en: Write down what the backup does not contain
title.zh: 把备份范围写在操作旁边

paragraphs.en: The JSON backup carries record metadata and detection results, but not the original images. A restored report cannot recreate its source photograph. The existing preview states this explicitly.
paragraphs.zh: JSON 备份包含记录元数据和检测结果，不包含原图片。因此恢复报告不等于恢复照片；现有导入预览明确写出了这一点。

paragraphs.en: If a future version supports image bundles, it would also need file manifests, integrity checks, missing-image behavior and storage estimates. Those are follow-up design tasks, not features implied by the current export button.
paragraphs.zh: 如果后续支持打包图片，还需要文件清单、完整性校验、图片缺失时的显示方式和容量估算。这些应单独设计，不能从当前“导出备份”按钮推断已经实现。

title.zh: 可以亲手做的一次恢复练习

bullets.en: Use synthetic records. Export one, change its local note, then import the older backup and inspect the conflict comparison.
bullets.zh: 使用演示记录：先导出一条，再修改本地备注，最后导入旧备份，检查冲突对比。

bullets.en: Keep the local record once, then repeat and explicitly replace it. Confirm the two choices have different outcomes.
bullets.zh: 先选择保留本地记录，再重复导入并明确选择覆盖，核对两次结果是否不同。

bullets.en: Try an invalid schema version and a file with repeated ids. Neither should silently become an accepted record.
bullets.zh: 用不支持的格式版本和文件内重复编号检查失败提示，不能静默变成有效记录。

bullets.en: At the record limit, try adding one more. Check that an error leaves the previous list intact.
bullets.zh: 达到记录上限后再尝试新增，确认提示失败且原列表完整保留。

title.en: Make the decision visible before the write

paragraphs.en: This is the same lesson I would apply to batch imports, configuration uploads and migration tools: classify the change, show its effect, and recheck the baseline before committing. A successful parser is only the beginning.
paragraphs.zh: 批量导入、配置上传和迁移工具，都可以沿用这一思路：先分类变化，再展示影响，提交前复查基线。能读进文件只是第一步，把覆盖和失败的后果讲清楚，才算完成交互设计。

label.en: v1.2 backup parsing and merge logic
label.zh: v1.2 备份解析与合并逻辑
